motors.title: Motors — {email}
motors.titleTip: The catalog this account sees. Nothing granted = empty catalog.
motors.empty: The catalog has no dies yet.
motors.defaultTip: Configure opens on this die and configuration until the user picks his own. Only granted dies are listed.
motors.grantTip: Private configurations of the catalog. Tick one to let the account open it, even when its die is not granted; admins always see everything.
motors.accessTip: Two levels: each die, and each of its configurations (expand a row). A configuration set to As motor follows its die; Private, Public or Selected clients override it, so a private die can still open one configuration.

cfgNote.public: every signed-in user, even if the die is private

motors.dieOpenTip: The die is private; these configurations are open on their own: {list}

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.chartDaily: Page views and visitors per day
analytics.chartHourly: Page views and visitors per hour
analytics.unavailable: Analytics backend not configured or not reachable. Ask the server owner to set the Umami environment variables.
analytics.forbidden: Admin access is required to see analytics.

activity.title: Activity
activity.line: Active time per account while the app is open, in use and visible (server clock).
activity.help: Counted from a heartbeat every 60 s while the tab is visible and the user touched it in the last 5 minutes; a gap or an idle spell counts nothing. Only the tab id is recorded. Daily totals are kept 13 months, then aggregate-only. Runs = finished jobs from the usage records (7 d / 30 d). Click a row for the daily chart.

verification.title: Verification
verification.help: Applicants who signed the model NDA online. VERIFIED opens the 3-D tools and the STEP download. MANUAL_REVIEW needs a person; MORE_INFORMATION_REQUIRED waits for the applicant. A registry-grade source (GLEIF, Companies House, VIES) must confirm the company and at least two independent signals, one of them strong, must link the person.
verification.notConfirmed: not confirmed by a registry-grade source
verification.actionsHelp: Approve opens the 3-D tools and the STEP download. Ask for more sends your text to the applicant as a templated mail. Deny closes the request. Re-run repeats every check. A reason is required; every action is audited.
verification.reasonPlaceholder: Reason, or the question for the applicant
